[[File:FuelComputer-CotF.png|thumb|right|250px|Ahsoka Tano and Anakin Skywalker access the fuel computer on Cad Bane's ''Xanadu Blood''.]]
A '''fuel computer''' was a part of some [[Starship/Legends|starships]]' operational systems. It kept track of where and when the ship was refueled.<ref name="Children of the Force">{{TCW|Children of the Force}}</ref>

By cross-referencing planets a subject was known to have visited with the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] they refueled on, one would be able to calculate where else the subject may have gone. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] would use this technique to track down [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]].<ref name="Children of the Force" />

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TCWdates|203}}</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] tracked the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] using his fuel computer, as he had wiped all other memory from the databank of his ship, the [[Xanadu Blood/Legends|''Xanadu Blood'']].<ref name="Children of the Force" />
